response.original_title: Tocats per Lucho: El millor Barça B de la història
response.overview: In ‘Tocats per Lucho’, we can relive Barça B’s promotion to the Second Division during the 2009-10 season, as well as the reserve team’s best-ever campaign in that tier. This took place in the 2010-11 season, when the side managed by Luis Enrique finished in third place—equaling the reserve team’s all-time best league position—while setting unprecedented records for points and goals in the Second Division. They amassed 71 points and scored 85 goals.
response.title: Touched by Lucho: The Best Barça B in history
